sloka: चत्वरेषु चतुष्केषु राजमार्गे तथैव च ।घोषयन्ति कपिं सर्वे चारीक इति राक्षसाः ।। 5.53.22।।।।
transliteration: catvareṣu catuṣkeṣu rājamārge tathaiva ca ।ghoṣayanti kapiṁ sarve cārīka iti rākṣasāḥ ।। 5.53.22।।।।

translations.english: All the demons went forth through cross roads, altars built on four pillars and royal roads announcing that he (Hanuman) was a spy.
